```kotlin
package com.cowave.search.client.proxy_api
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration
import org.springframework.graphql.client.HttpGraphQlClient
import org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.WebClient
@Configuration
class ProxyApiClientConfig(
    private val prop: ProxyApiClientProperties,
) {
    @Bean("ProxyHttpGraphQlClient")
    fun httpGraphQlClient(): HttpGraphQlClient {
        return HttpGraphQlClient.builder(WebClient.create(prop.baseUrl))
            .headers { it.setBasicAuth(prop.username, prop.password) }
            .build()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.cowave.search.client.proxy_api
import com.cowave.shared.utils.logger
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier
import org.springframework.graphql.client.HttpGraphQlClient
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
@Component
class ProxyApiClient(
    @field:Qualifier("ProxyHttpGraphQlClient")
    private val client: HttpGraphQlClient
) {
    private val logger by logger()
    fun <T> query(query: String, variables: Map<String, Any> = emptyMap(), retrievePath: String, classType: Class<T>): List<T> {
        return try {
            client.document(query).variables(variables).retrieveSync(retrievePath).toEntityList(classType)
        } catch (ex: Exception) {
            logger.error { ex }
            throw ex
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.cowave.search.outbound_adapter.proxy
import com.cowave.search.client.proxy_api.ProxyApiClient
import com.cowave.search.domain.proxy.mall.Mall
import com.cowave.search.domain.proxy.mall.MallRepository
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
@Component
class MallRepositoryImpl(
    private val client: ProxyApiClient,
) : MallRepository {
    override fun findAllByIds(mallIds: List<Int>): List<Mall> {
        val query = """
            query GetMalls(${'$'}ids: [Int!]) {
                malls(input: {  ids: ${'$'}ids }) {
                    items {
                        mallId
                        mallUseYnDanawa
                        mallUseYnEnuri
                    }
                }
            }
        """.trimIndent()
        return client.query(query = query, variables = mapOf("ids" to mallIds), retrievePath = "malls.items", Mall::class.java)
    }
}
```
